title: silicone grease lid
text: silicone grease lid. I purchased this because of the fold up handle.  I have a tiny house and space is a premium.  You can strain with it - but it is a bit of trick to do - it's best task is stop grease splatter - but also works as vented lid while on the stove.  I hand wash, but you could put in the dishwasher.  Hand folds and sits nicely in small area.  I like it.  The main lid portion is vented silicone, the handle is silver metal and appears to be stainless.  However, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful!

product_metadata.title: SKEMIX 11.5" Silicone Splatter Screen - Pan Cover with Folding Handle, High Heat Resistant Oil Splash Guard - Heat Insulation Cooling Mat, Strainer, Drain Board for Frying Pan（Grey）
features: FOLDABLE HANDLE - Foldable handle for easy storage and keep you from burning your hand. Great product. Love the way that the handle folds in so that it doesn't take up as much room.
NON-STICK & EASY TO CLEAN - Just put it on the pan and no more trouble about sticking. Wash it in the water with dish soap or just throw it in the dishwasher.

MULTI USE KITCHEN TOOLS - Using as a grease and splatter screen, strainer, cooling mat, and also a drain board. As a pan cover/splatter screen avoid grease and sauce splatters.
